server: llama-server of llama.cpp build 12375 (commit 9d25e0014), the image's /app/llama-server, on CPU with 4 threads, a context of 4096 tokens and 4 slots, the port published on the loopback address only
workload: the model stories15M-q4_0.gguf (sha256 66967fbece6dbe97886593fdbb73589584927e29119ec31f08090732d1861739) from https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/models/resolve/main/tinyllamas/stories15M-q4_0.gguf, a conversion of https://huggingface.co/karpathy/tinyllamas (MIT licence), served under the name stories15M; the model is not part of the repository
command: guidellm run --backend kind=openai_http,target=http://127.0.0.1:8000 --profile kind=constant,rate=2 --constraint kind=max_duration,seconds=10 --data kind=synthetic_text,prompt_tokens=32,output_tokens=32 --tokenizer kind=huggingface_auto,model=gpt2 --seed kind=static,value=1234 --output kind=json,path=out/r2.json --disable-console-interactive
replaced: every one of the 20 successful requests kept; per request only type_, request_start_time, request_end_time, request_latency, prompt_tokens, output_tokens, time_to_first_token_ms, time_per_output_token_ms, inter_token_latency_ms, output_tokens_per_second kept (the request arguments, the output text, ids and timings dropped); metrics kept to time_to_first_token_ms, inter_token_latency_ms, output_tokens_per_second, requests_per_second, output_token_count, each to its successful requests' mean, median, min, max, count, total_sum and p50, p90, p95, p99; the run configuration, the scheduler state and the conclusions dropped; metadata.platform replaced by 'made-up-platform'; every clock reading moved by a whole number of seconds so that the run starts at 1000000000 s since the epoch (the time between two readings is kept)
